skill.summary: Coware Living Specs — shared API spec sync for multi-agent coding teams. TRIGGER when: project has .coware/ directory, user mentions shared specs, API alignm...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Coware skill for managing shared API specs in multi-agent coding teams.
- Detects usage based on presence of `.coware/` directory and references to team/API/spec sync.
- Guides agents through initialization, spec syncing (`pull.mjs`/`sync.mjs`), and strict adherence to shared interface specs.
- Enforces a structured Markdown format for specs in `.coware/specs/`.
- Details procedures for setup, coding workflows, spec updates, and troubleshooting.
- Includes instructions for teammate onboarding via invite code.
